"""Predict the response and trajectory from the calibrated panel operators."""

import numpy as np


def _affine_reference(panel):
    u, v = panel['u'], panel['v']
    coeffs = []
    for j in range(u.shape[1]):
        design = np.column_stack((np.ones(len(u)), u[:, j]))
        coeff = np.linalg.lstsq(design, v[:, j], rcond=None)[0]
        for _ in range(8):
            keep = np.argsort(np.abs(design @ coeff - v[:, j]))[:int(0.80 * len(u))]
            coeff = np.linalg.lstsq(design[keep], v[keep, j], rcond=None)[0]
        coeffs.append(coeff)

def orth(z, v):
    (a, b) = (z.mean(0), v.mean(0))
    z = z - a
    w = v - b
    (P, D, Q) = np.linalg.svd(z.T @ w)
    M = P @ Q * (D.sum() / np.sum(z * z))
    return (M, b - a @ M)

def score(g, iy, tar, pen):
    n = len(iy)
    v = np.setdiff1d(np.arange(len(tar)), iy)
    scale = np.std(g[iy], axis=0)
    scale = np.where(scale < 1e-09, 1, scale)
    a = (g - g[iy].mean(0)) / scale
    m = tar[iy].mean(0)
    b = a[iy]
    K = b @ b.T
    pr = a[v] @ b.T @ np.linalg.solve(K + pen * np.eye(n), tar[iy] - m) + m
    e = np.abs(pr - tar[v])
    return np.r_[e[:, 0].mean(), e[:, 1:].mean()]

def pred(g, i, j, Y, reg):
    z = g - g[i].mean(0)
    scale = np.std(z[i], axis=0)
    z = z / np.where(scale < 1e-09, 1.0, scale)
    b = z[i]
    m = Y[i].mean(0)
    return z[j] @ b.T @ np.linalg.solve(b @ b.T + reg * np.eye(len(i)), Y[i] - m) + m
